errors.text_span: Starting at approximately 3.3, the Vanilla line decreases steeply to around 2.65 at 20,000 iterations
errors.evidence: Description states the starting point is 3.3 and 2.65 at 20,000 iterations, but the plot shows the Vanilla line decreases from more than 3.4 to around 2.7.
Description states StrmLLM (n=64) drops to 2.7 at 20,000 iterations, but the plot actually shows it reaches about 2.6.
The description suggests the SepLLM lines start higher than the plot indicates, where they start above 3.4.
The description does not mention the variance shown in the plot, indicated by lighter shades around each line.
The description does not specify the presence of a legend.
The machine-generated description does not indicate the chart's purpose of illustrating loss over iterations.
